source:
@@U03427@@
(Shaking himself.)

@@U03428@@
Can't say I’ve learned too much from all this.
It’s as much a rat race here as in the North!
Stupid!
Ghosts, no matter where,
are equally ridiculous, and poets
not one jot less perverse than the people.
The world, I’d say, is one great masquerade,
a dance to titillate the senses.
I grasped at ravishing masks,
and in my grip found creatures
that made me shudder.
Ah, how I long to deceive myself,
if only the deception lasted longer!

@@U03429@@
(Losing his way among the rocks.)

@@U03430@@
Where have I come to?
Where does this lead?
I arrived on paths smooth and flat,
and now this rubble of rocks and boulders.
I clamber uphill,
I clamber down,
and never find my 斯芬克斯们!
It’s mad, it’s insane,
a mountain like this in a single night!
I'd call that some lively witches’ ride!
They bring their 布洛克斯山 with them!

@@U03432@@
(From a natural cliff.)

@@U03433@@
Come! Climb up!
My mountains are old!
Unchanged throughout antiquity!
Show reverence for my rocky steeps!
Come!
The farthest spurs of the 品都斯山 Range!
I stood here unshaken as I stand here now
when Pompey fled across me.
These illusions you see around you
translation:
@@U03427@@
（浑身发抖。）

@@U03428@@
不能说我从这一切中学到了太多。
这里和北方一样都是一场激烈的竞争！
愚蠢的！
鬼魂，无论在哪里，
同样可笑，诗人
与人民相比，他们的邪恶丝毫不减。
我想说，世界是一场伟大的化装舞会，
一种刺激感官的舞蹈。
我抓住了迷人的面具，
在我的手中发现了生物
这让我不寒而栗。
啊，我多么渴望欺骗自己，
要是欺骗持续得更久就好了！

@@U03429@@
（在岩石中迷了路。）

@@U03430@@
我这是到哪儿了？
这会导致什么结果呢？
我到达平坦平坦的道路，
现在是这片岩石和巨石的瓦砾。
我爬上坡，
我爬下来，
永远找不到我的斯芬克斯们！
这很疯狂，这很疯狂，
一夜之间就到了这样的山！
我称之为一些活泼的女巫之旅！
他们带着布洛克斯山！

@@U03432@@
（来自天然悬崖。）

@@U03433@@
来吧！爬上去！
我的山已经老了！
自古以来未曾改变！
对我的岩石陡峭表示崇敬！
来！
品都斯山脉最远的山脊！
我站在这里毫不动摇，就像我现在站在这里一样
当庞培从我身边逃走时。
你在周围看到的这些幻象
